coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 11 of 17 ground-truth variable items (65%): consistent train/validation/test splitting, sequence length, forecast horizon, cycle length, model type, input/output dimensions, synthetic-data parameters, normalization method, cycle-index generation, MSE, and MAE.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses AdamW instead of Adam, 50 epochs instead of 30, and batch sizes 32–128 rather than the reference 256. Omits the single RTX 4090 with 24GB memory requirement, does not test enabling versus disabling RevIN, and does not specify training-loss or learned-cycle visualization outputs. Model-type coverage is primarily through baselines and architectural ablations rather than an explicit linear/MLP configuration.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state the expected result: a trained CycleNet that accurately forecasts future time-series values, with visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
